short: The London folk hero whose cat makes his fortune.
note: The legendary poor boy who goes to London and becomes wealthy through his remarkable cat, eventually serving as Lord Mayor. The legend attaches to the historical merchant Richard Whittington.

short: A deceptive show of prosperity or success.
note: An impressive outward display intended to conceal an undesirable reality; named for allegedly staged villages shown to Catherine the Great by Grigory Potemkin.

short: A fierce Hindu goddess and divine mother.
note: A Hindu goddess associated with destruction, protection, and the power of the divine mother, often depicted with weapons and a garland of severed heads.
